purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a Divided City marriage-rumor disclosure path beneath a working Sunwall cargo lift.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary civic marriage work, a captured rumor, a house archive packet, omitted sponsor actions, a loaded lift, four disclosure routes, and four state-gated aftermath families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the gallery establishing view, couple and office routine, rumor-sheet closeup, preparation choice, routine fold, courier arrival, sealed-packet choice, disclosure closeup, lift-bell turn, disclosure-path choice, final threshold, and each ending family. The courier arrival and first lift bell stand as their own replay beats because each changes the active power geometry.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete visible frame in ordinary image-model language. It names geometry, materials, lighting, objects, bodies, and staging. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints; prompt assembly sends only the style cue, visible character refs, base prompt, and triggered modifiers.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, crisp readable silhouettes, immense worn stone infrastructure, warm ochre lamplight against blue-violet permanent twilight, restrained prophetic strangeness, intimate civic detail, abstract unlettered record marks, dry humane visual wit.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every generation prompt from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters and groups visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Use a camera-specific blockout as visual input before high-consistency multi-angle replay rendering.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one long gallery from wide, desk, object-closeup, stair, and lift-hatch angles. The textual map below supports staging review and prompt-manifest work; it is not a renderable geometry asset.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before website-quality multi-angle rendering, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout with the south shadow stair, central copying rail, west provision wicket, north lift-service hatch, load board, rear staff stair, review bell, wall safe, notice rail, overhead cargo ribs, and fixed camera slots.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a long narrow civic gallery built from dark worn stone beneath a colossal vertical cargo-lift landing. Heavy ceiling ribs and chains shiver with grain moving overhead. Blue-violet permanent twilight enters from a broad stair descending to a crowded lower ward at the south end. A waist-high wooden copying rail and chained open register occupy the center. A barred lift-service handoff box and chalked load board sit on the north wall. A west-side provision wicket contains slate trays and brass sun-court tokens. A narrow rear staff stair rises beside a bronze review bell and a black iron record safe. Small ochre lamps pool light over ink, wax, stone dust, and a partly eaten sun-shaped loaf.
visual_continuity_notes: The gallery is one rectangular civic room beneath the lift landing. The shadow stair, copying rail, provision wicket, lift handoff, load board, staff stair, bell, safe, and notice rail keep fixed relative positions.

Permanent twilight enters from the south stair. Ochre civic lamps provide the main interior light. Overhead load movement appears through chain vibration and falling dust, not an open view into the shaft.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide civic desk scene under warm ochre lamps. Pera Sen, a medium-brown-skinned clerk with cropped coiled hair, ink-stained fingers, layered russet civic robe, and brass keys, stands behind a waist-high copying rail over a chained register and two separate leaves. Ari Venn, a slim young adult with pale olive skin, large dark eyes, shaved temples, a braided dark crown, and a mended fine gray house coat, stands beside Dema Kor, a broad-shouldered brown-skinned lift fitter with short copper curls, blue-gray work wrap, leather tool strap, and a waxed brake strip. Two wedding witnesses in plain work wraps hold a partly eaten sun-shaped loaf. Mira Tesh, a stocky older clerk with a gray braid and green ward apron, sorts slate trays and brass tokens behind the west provision wicket. Massive ceiling ribs and chains tremble above the intimate paperwork.

occlusion_rules: The cargo lift and its operating steward remain beyond the north wall and stone ceiling; only the barred handoff, a gloved hand, bells, chalk, chains, and vibration are visible from the gallery.

review_notes: The visual plan contains a textual scene-set map with fixed zones, camera slots, routes, sightlines, and occlusion rules. A renderable plan view or 3D blockout remains required before high-consistency multi-angle website art.
Every base prompt uses affirmative visible description and restates the relevant gallery geometry, light, materials, bodies, and props.
House cord colors, hold-ring, exact bell use, character appearances, and room layout remain fixture-local; the visual artifact does not promote them into universal Divided City procedure.
Branch and ending modifiers carry packet custody, record separation, brake-strip route, rumor/correction route, support state, house pressure, and lift-chain state into later frames.
